title: Install or recover Iatreion
summary: Install, verify, inspect, or recover the stateless Iatreion command and matching Chancery provider without operating product state.
use_when: Iatreion should be installed or its owned installation should be verified or recovered.
do_not_use_when: Only an operational report is needed.
outcome: A version-matched immutable Iatreion release with coherent command and provider selectors.
effects: Installation changes Iatreion-owned release artifacts and selectors. Inspection and verification are read-only.
authority: Iatreion owns only its installed command, installer, provider bundle, and selectors.
success: The exact binary, installer, and provider versions and integrity match one selected immutable release.
failure_and_recovery: Refuse foreign, stale, or tampered selectors. Restore only an exact supported retained release.
privacy: Installation retains executable and documentation bytes. It retains no report, product state, or credential.
steps: Build the exact Iatreion and installer candidates after CI succeeds.
Install the exact binary and provider bundle with an optional expected-current selection.
Inspect or verify the selected release and recover only a proved retained release.
checkpoints: The command, installer, and provider selectors identify one immutable release.
Installation changes no product state, service, schedule, or Semantics registration.
adaptation: Use an explicit alternate home only for an intentional isolated current-user boundary.
stop_when: The candidate, selector, or prior release basis is foreign, stale, tampered, or unprovable.

interfaces.label: Install
interfaces.invocation: iatreion-install install --binary ABS --bundle ABS [--home ABS] [--expected-current absent|releases/HASH]

does_not_authorize: Release publication, deployment of product probes, or product operation.

consumers.statement: The current operator may install or recover Iatreion.

preconditions.statement: A version-matched exact candidate and a coherent prior selector basis.

inputs.statement: Exact binary, matching provider bundle, current installer, optional home and expected selection, or one retained release.

outputs.statement: One coherent immutable Iatreion installation or a read-only inspection result.

data_semantics.statement: Installed bytes establish Iatreion availability, not the status of other products.

identity_and_units.statement: Release identity, provider release, contract version, and report schema are independent.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: The operation covers one exact candidate and prior installation basis.

access.statement: Current-user local filesystem access is bounded to Iatreion-owned release and selector paths.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: The shared Cell installer advances the command, installer, and provider selectors coherently or restores the proved prior state.

operational_limits.statement: No database, daemon, schedule, migration, network request, or semantic registration is involved.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: The installation uses the shared cell-install-v1 manifest and adapter protocol one.

reliances.statement: The product-owned installer links the shared installation library and invokes no represented capability.
